summary: The registrant filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 to disclose its net asset value per share for each class of common shares as of May 31, 2026. Six classes (S, I, F-S, F-I, D-S, E) are reported with NAV per share ranging from $10.4688 to $11.0405, plus Class A OP Units at $11.3880. Total portfolio NAV is $1.9085 billion on 178.509 million shares/units. The filing is a routine monthly NAV update by a non-traded REIT, not a special-situation event. There are no acquisition, divestiture, activist, tender, going-private, or other corporate action terms. This is purely informational, providing periodic valuation disclosure without triggering any special-situation category.
